response.sql:
SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS conservation_record_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS status_share
FROM scanconservation AS c
JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL insurance status forms its own group, as SQLite does when grouping NULL values.
